title: Design System: World of Dissonance Compendium

display.purpose: Title-page title on cloth, in Soft Gilt.

headline.purpose: Entry title in the chapter band.

title.purpose: Section heads (h2) with § number and hairline above.

title-sm.purpose: Subsection heads (h3); skill record names and pager titles at 19px.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked apparatus: running head, thumbs, table heads, stat labels, h4.

shadows.name: results-sheet
shadows.purpose: Search results dropdown only; the one floating layer.

shadows.name: tab-notch
shadows.purpose: Paper-coloured cut beside the current desktop thumb tab.

shadows.name: phone-tab-marker
shadows.purpose: Current or hovered tab in the phone bottom strip.

motion.name: thumb-slide
motion.purpose: Thumb tabs sliding out on hover and when current.

motion.name: strip-snap
motion.purpose: Picture strips snapping plate to plate.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: bottom thumb strip, static masthead, stacked band, collapsible contents.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: 180px margin column, one-column home contents.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: 64px column gap, § numbers hung in the gutter.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gilt action on the cloth title page.
components.html: Begin at Vol. I
components.css: .ds-cloth { background: var(--cloth, #1d4a52); padding: 24px; } .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--cloth-line, #33656c); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--cloth-text, #e3eeea); text-decoration: none; font: 700 14px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--gilt, #c9a227); border-color: var(--gilt, #c9a227); color: #1f1806; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gilt-soft, #e7cf7c); color: #1f1806; }

components.name: Cloth Button
components.description: Secondary title-page action: outline on cloth, gilt on hover.
components.css: .ds-cloth { background: var(--cloth, #1d4a52); padding: 24px; } .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--cloth-line, #33656c); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--cloth-text, #e3eeea); text-decoration: none; font: 700 14px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--gilt-soft, #e7cf7c); border-color: var(--gilt, #c9a227); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Recessed search well in the cloth masthead; '/' focuses it.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-cloth { background: var(--cloth, #1d4a52); padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); } .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 460px; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: var(--cloth-mute, #bcd4cf); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 40px; border: 1px solid var(--cloth-line, #33656c); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--cloth-deep, #153840); color: #fff; font: 500 15px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--cloth-mute, #bcd4cf); } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gilt, #c9a227); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gilt, #c9a227) 30%, transparent); } .ds-search kbd { position: absolute; right: 10px; font: 600 12px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; color: var(--cloth-text, #e3eeea); border: 1px solid var(--cloth-line, #33656c); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 6px; }

components.name: Thumb Index
components.description: Six volume tabs on the fore-edge; current pulls flush, last-read wears the gilt ribbon.
components.html: ILoreHistory, regionsIIPeoplesRaces, Eon-KinIIIAspectsAstra, Fibero, EternumIVArcanaArcana, skill treesVRulesRolls, combatVICatalogsItems, relics
components.css: .ds-thumbs { width: 132px; display: grid; grid-auto-rows: 72px; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--page-edge, #e9ece5), var(--page, #f6f7f3)); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6dbd3); } .ds-thumb { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; margin-left: 20px; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; border-radius: 12px 0 0 12px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; background: var(--t); transition: margin-left .28s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); } .ds-thumb:hover { margin-left: 10px; } .ds-thumb[aria-current] { margin-left: 0; box-shadow: -10px 0 0 -4px var(--page, #f6f7f3); } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-num { font: 700 12px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; } .ds-label { font: 700 15px/1.1 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-thumb small { font: 500 12px/1.3 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 90%, var(--t)); } .ds-ribbon { position: absolute; top: -7px; right: 16px; width: 12px; height: 40px; background: var(--gilt, #c9a227); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 78%, 0 100%); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-thumb { transition: none; } }

components.name: Chapter Band
components.description: Entry opening in the volume ink, with sibling entries as tabs opening onto the page.
components.html:
Vol. IIPeoples

The Cords of Tantalos

  1. Species
  2. The Cords of Tantalos
  3. Eon-Kin
components.css: .ds-band { --vol: var(--peoples, #2f6b4f); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: end; column-gap: 32px; row-gap: 14px; background: var(--vol); color: #fff; padding: 34px 40px 0 28px; } .ds-vol { margin: 0 0 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font: 700 30px/1 "Spectral SC", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-vol span { font: 700 12px/1.6 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-band h1 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 700 clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 48px)/1.08 "Spectral SC", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-band ol { grid-column: 2; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 4px; } .ds-band a { display: block; padding: 8px 12px 9px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03em; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; } .ds-band a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 16%, var(--vol)); } .ds-band a[aria-current] { background: var(--page, #f6f7f3); color: var(--ink, #16202b); } .ds-band a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-table { --vol: var(--arcana, #6b3f8f); border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #16202b); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #16202b); overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 500 15px/1.45 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #16202b); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: var(--ink, #16202b); padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6dbd3); vertical-align: top; } .ds-table td:first-child { font-weight: 700; } .ds-table td strong { color: var(--vol); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vol) 6%, var(--page, #f6f7f3)); }

components.css: .ds-record { --vol: var(--arcana, #6b3f8f); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6dbd3); padding: 14px 0 16px; color: var(--ink, #16202b); } .ds-rec-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 18px; } .ds-rec-name { font: 700 19px/1.25 "Spectral SC", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-stamp { font: 700 12px/1 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: var(--vol); padding: 4px 7px 3px; } .ds-record p { margin: 2px 0 4px; font: 400 17px/1.6 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; } .ds-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 18px; font: 400 13px/1.5 "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-stats b { font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mute, #5b6570); margin-right: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-volume { --vol: var(--rules, #a8561a); color: var(--ink, #16202b); font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; } .ds-volume h2 { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--vol); color: #fff; font: 700 26px/1.1 "Spectral SC", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-volume h2 span { font: 700 12px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-volume p { margin: 10px 0 6px; color: var(--ink-2, #3a4450); font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; } .ds-volume ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-volume a { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #e4e8e1); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 18px; } .ds-volume a:hover .ds-t { color: var(--vol); } .ds-volume a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dots { flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px dotted #a9b0a8; transform: translateY(-4px); min-width: 20px; } .ds-c { font: 600 13px "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--mute, #5b6570); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The wiki is set as a bound reference work on Tantalos: a teal book-cloth cover with a gilt rule and crescent stamp, cool India-paper leaves, and six coloured thumb tabs cut into the right edge, one per volume (Lore, Peoples, Aspects, Arcana, Rules, Catalogs). Every surface behaves like a page in that book. A volume colour owns its chapter band, its thumb tab, its section numbers and its list markers; nothing else borrows it.

Density is that of a good encyclopedia: a ~68ch reading column, a contents margin to its left, a running head with guide words above it, and sections numbered with § so any passage can be cited at the table. Entries are separated by space and hairline rules, never by boxes. Reference tables carry their hierarchy in weight, case and a reversed ink head, never in size.

The page is a single committed light theme (`color-scheme: light`). There is no dark variant by design: it is a book read under lamplight or beside the game, and the previous dark docs-site look is the confirmed rejection. Grey page trees, dark themes and floating cards are the anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Cloth-and-gilt masthead, colophon and title page; paper everywhere else.
Six volume colours, each scoped to one volume through a single `--vol` variable.
Thumb index as primary navigation: right edge on desktop, fixed bottom strip on phones.
§ numbering hung in the left gutter at 1101px and wider.
Hairlines and ink rules instead of cards; flat paper with one floating layer (search results).
Three faces with fixed jobs: Spectral SC headwords, Source Serif 4 text, Archivo Narrow labels and data.

rules.name: The One Volume Rule
rules.body: Volume colour is set once per page through `--vol` (a `v-*` class on body or on a home-page volume section) and never hard-coded on a component. A page wears exactly one volume ink; the home contents and the thumb index are the only places all six appear together.

rules.name: The Gilt Is Metal Rule
rules.body: Gilt appears as rules, the seal, the ribbon, focus and the one primary action. It never fills a text area or becomes a body-text colour on paper.

rules.name: The One Light Page Rule
rules.body: There is no dark variant. Do not add `prefers-color-scheme: dark` styles; the cloth surfaces already supply the dark notes.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Spectral SC names things, Source Serif 4 tells things, Archivo Narrow labels and counts things. A face never takes another face's job.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: In tables and records, rank by weight, case and reversal (ink head with white type, a volume-coloured cost stamp), never by enlarging type.

rules.name: The Section Mark Rule
rules.body: h2 and h3 carry a § number (§3, §3.1) in Archivo Narrow 700 in the volume ink. From 1101px it hangs in the left gutter at 14px; below that it sits inline at 0.62em.

rules.name: The No Cards Rule
rules.body: Entries, volumes, records and results are separated by space and hairlines (rule, rule-soft) or a 2px ink head rule. Never wrap content in a bordered, shadowed or rounded box.

dos: **Do** scope every volume colour through `--vol` and the `v-*` / `t-*` classes; components read `var(--vol)`.
**Do** separate content with space and the rule / rule-soft hairlines, and head tables and the pager with a 2px ink rule.
**Do** rank table and record information by weight, case and reversal: an ink head row, a volume-coloured cost stamp, uppercase 11-12px labels.
**Do** keep every new heading numbered with § and let it hang in the gutter at 1101px and wider.
**Do** keep gilt to 3px rules, the seal, the ribbon, focus and the single primary action.
**Do** keep phone navigation in the fixed bottom thumb strip and let the masthead scroll away.
donts: **Don't** add a dark theme or `prefers-color-scheme: dark` styles; the single light page is deliberate.
**Don't** wrap entries, volumes, records or results in cards (bordered, rounded or shadowed boxes).
**Don't** enlarge type to signal importance inside tables or records.
**Don't** use a volume colour outside its own volume, or put two volume inks on one entry page.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the search results sheet and the field focus halo.
**Don't** set body text in Spectral SC or Archivo Narrow, or headwords in Source Serif 4.
